verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side, let Israel say,
if the LORD had not been on our side when people attacked us,
they would have swallowed us alive when their anger burned against us.
The flood would have swept us away. The river would have flowed over us.
The raging waters would have swept us away.
Praise the LORD, who has not let their teeth tear us apart.
We have escaped like a bird from the hunter's trap. The trap has been broken, and we have escaped.
Our help comes from the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
